name: What types of doors can Frasheski Construction install?

mainEntity.name: What types of doors can Frasheski Construction install?

acceptedAnswer.text: Frasheski Construction installs a wide variety of doors, including interior and exterior doors, pre-hung doors, slab doors, sliding doors, French doors, and custom-designed doors. We also handle specialized installations like fire-rated doors or doors requiring specific security hardware. The choice often depends on the door's function, material, and the aesthetic you want to achieve for your property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Frasheski Construction installs various doors including interior, exterior, sliding, French, and custom doors, as well as specialized and fire-rated options.
